items.decision: approve Commission Vice President Arce for Commission President
items.text: Annual Election of Officers: Discussion and possible action to elect a President and Vice President of the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission (SFPUC), each to serve a one-year term, in accordance with the SFPUC City and County of San Francisco Rules of Order, Rule 6. President Stacy explained the process for the election of officers and opened public comment for the election of the Commission President

items.title: CONSENT CALENDAR

Authorize the General Manager of the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission to designate Emerson Process Management Power & Water Solutions, Inc., as the sole source subcontractor to supply equipment and provide services for the distributed process control system specified in the Request for Proposals for Wastewater Enterprise Design-Build Contract No. DB-141, Southeast Water Pollution Control Plant Nutrient Reduction, to match other products in use and ensure system-wide consistency, in conformance with San Francisco Administrative Code Section 6.73(e) and California Public Contract Code Section 3400(c)(2)

Approve Modification No. 3 to Job Order Contract No. JOC-90, General Engineering (A-License) Construction, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, and Alameda Counties, with GSW Construction, Inc., to increase the contract duration by one year, for a total contract duration of four years, with no change to the contract amount, to provide additional time for facility and asset improvements

Approve Modification No. 1 to Job Order Contract No. JOC-101, General Engineering (A License) Construction, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, and Alameda Counties, with Fontenoy Engineering, to increase the contract not-to-exceed amount by $2,500,000, for a revised not-to-exceed contract amount of $7,500,000, and to increase the contract duration by three years, for a total contract duration of five years, to provide additional time and capacity for facility and asset improvements

Approve Modification No. 1 to Job Order Contract No. JOC-108, General Engineering (A-License) Construction, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, and Alameda Counties, with Anvil Builders, Inc., to increase the contract not-to-exceed amount by $2,500,000, for a revised not-to-exceed contract amount of $7,500,000, and to increase the contract duration by three years, for a total contract duration of five years, to provide additional time and capacity for facility and asset improvements

Award professional services Contract No. PRO.0271, Harrison/Treat Box Sewer Construction Management Staff Augmentation Services, to Jacobs-Avila, a Joint Venture, in the amount not to exceed $4,985,000 and with a duration of 40 months (three years and four months), to augment construction management services for public work Contract No. WW-719CR, Folsom Area Stormwater Improvements – Harrison/Treat Box Sewers and Connecting Auxiliary Sewers

Correct Resolution No. 25-0065 (May 13, 2025), to increase the construction duration for Contract No. WW-757R, Laguna, Howard, and Mission Creek Combined Sewer Discharge Improvements, by 60 consecutive calendar days to match the total contract duration of 570 consecutive calendar days stated in Addendum No. 6 to the Bid Specifications for Contract No. WW-757R, Laguna, Howard, and Mission Creek Combined Sewer Discharge Improvements, with no change to the contract amount
Authorize the General Manager to consent to the Development Agreement and adopt findings pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
items.text: Authorize the General Manager to consent, on behalf of the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission, to the Development Agreement between the City and County of San Francisco and Prologis L.P., a Delaware limited partnership, as it relates to matters under the SFPUC’s jurisdiction; and adopt findings pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) and a Mitigation and Monitoring and Reporting Program

items.title: Approve the revised terms and conditions and authorize the General Manager to execute a Purchase and Sale Agreement and Easement Deeds with Sunol Glen Unified School District
items.text: Approve the revised terms and conditions and authorize the General Manager to execute a Purchase and Sale Agreement and Easement Deeds with Sunol Glen Unified School District for the acquisition of a 4,008-square-foot easement for an underground water pipeline and associated appurtenances and a 34,834-square-foot temporary construction easement on and across a portion of Alameda County Assessor’s Parcel No. 096-0155- 004-01, located at 11601 Main Street, Sunol, California, for $35,000, subject to Board of Supervisors and Mayor approval
